model.name: mergeAction.addPutLeft
model.description: BEHAVIOUR (ADD region (right adds lines), '>>' (left) clicked): PUTS the LEFT version of the region INTO the center (adds it). The right version can ALSO be added via '<<' - both coexist.
model.expectedBehaviour: PUTS the LEFT version of the region INTO the center (adds it). The right version can ALSO be added via '<<' - both coexist.
model.matrixOf: R30.35 merge-action matrix (REWORKED to ADD(>>/<<)/REMOVE(x) on a BOTH-VERSIONS center; NO ignore/dismiss/pick-side). Dual-link source of truth for architect PUML/SVG.
